name: DS Cluster D08: Economic Calendar (FRED + Treasury)
description: Tests: economic_calendar FRED mode (release_id=50 NFP, 10 CPI, 0 all), Treasury mode, calendar+indicator combo pattern.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D08: Economic Calendar
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === NFP RELEASE DATES ===
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)()
is_nfp = nfp_cal.is_released

# === CPI RELEASE DATES ===
cpi_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=10)()
is_cpi = cpi_cal.is_released

# === ALL FRED RELEASES ===
all_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=0)()
is_any_release = all_cal.is_released

# === TREASURY AUCTION CALENDAR ===
note10_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.Treasury, security_type=TreasurySecurityType.Note, term=TreasuryTerm.Y10)()
is_auction = note10_cal.is_released

# === CALENDAR + INDICATOR COMBO ===
# NFP value on announcement day (D08 core pattern)
nfp_src = economic_indicators(series_id="PAYEMS")()
nfp_val = ffill(nfp_src.result)
nfp_on_release = where(is_nfp, nfp_val)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.NewspaperIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Return", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="NFP Release"
    )
)((rets, is_nfp))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Return", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="CPI Release"
    )
)((rets, is_cpi))

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Return", dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="10Y Note Auction"
    )
)((rets, is_auction))
